name: print-social-carousel-black-blue-fluorescent-arch-shapes
title: Black and fluorescent-blue carousel with concentric arch shapes
whatItIs: A five-tile Instagram grid on black backgrounds, built from concentric electric-blue arch/rainbow shapes, bold sans headlines and a small diamond-brush texture accent.
whatItMeans: Concentric arch shapes glowing against pure black give a minimal two-color palette a strong sense of movement and depth, making 'neon' feel earned rather than just a color choice.
techniques: stack several concentric arch shapes at different radii to build implied depth and motion
keep the palette to exactly two colors (black, fluorescent blue) for maximum contrast punch
add one small brushed-texture accent shape to break up otherwise hard-edged vector shapes

vocabulary.definition: shapes sharing the same center point but differing in size, commonly used to imply radiating motion or depth
